name: mirage
text: You were right on both counts, and I've fixed both. I'm running the full tests now and will release right after. 1) The 0 resting was wrong. The engine has about 1,025 bids resting ($308), but the Bids tab was counting only this phone's own desk, which is empty while GitHub drives. The tab will now show the engine's real bids, fills and stop reason. 2) The Off toggle did not stop the engine. Engine bids ignored the Off and Recommend switches and posted whenever engine trading was LIVE. Now only Automatic lets the engine post. Off and Recommend take its bids down. I haven't audited every other setting on the tab yet. I'll do that next and tell you what I find, so the rest of the tab is checked too.
